current_answer: As of September 7, 2026, Grand Theft Auto VI is still committed to November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Confidence is supported by converging official listings, active preorders and preload logistics, Take-Two's current outlook, and the August extended look, but two prior official date movements mean this remains a commitment rather than a guarantee. No official PC platform or date is published in the sources checked.
summary: Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Preorders, November 12 preload logistics, and the August 27 extended look support an active launch campaign but do not guarantee delivery.
Two earlier official date movements limit confidence; no new official delay was found in the inspected pages.
No official PC platform or release date is published in the checked launch materials.
uncertainty: An official commitment is not a guarantee.
The PC sooner-than-expected report is unofficial and gives no date or window.
Launch hour, final performance, and some service details remain unknown.
freshness_note: Checked September 7, 2026. Recheck after any Rockstar, Take-Two, platform-store, or material schedule update.
